Jade_Heimerdinger.title: The Revered Inventor
Jade_Heimerdinger.lore:
- The abilities may look similar but are very different
- UPGRADE!!! (R) is a buff that lasts a set time not a single ability
- H-28G Evolution Turrets (Q) are active globally but die when Heimerdinger does
Jade_Heimerdinger.blurb:
- The abilities may look similar but are very different
- UPGRADE!!! (R) is a buff that lasts a set time not a single ability
- H-28G Evolution Turrets (Q) are active globally but die when Heimerdinger does

spells.name: H-28G Evolution Turret
spells.description: Heimerdinger lays down a machine gun turret. Turrets gain abilities as this skill is increased. (Turrets deal half damage to towers).
spells.tooltip:
Heimerdinger constructs a Machine Gun Turret that deals {{ bonusdamage }} magic damage per attack. Turrets gain {{ turretbonusattackspeed*100 }}% attack speed for the first {{ attackspeedduration }} seconds after being placed. This ability has {{ maxammo }} charges ({{ ammorechargetime }} second refresh).

Each rank of this skill grants a further enhancement:
Rank 2: Turret attacks reduce the target's Armor and Magic Resist by {{ level2resistshred }} (max {{ maxshredcaptooltip }})
Rank 3: Maximum turrets increased to 2
Rank 4: Turrets gain an additional {{ level4hptooltip }} Health
Rank 5: Turret attacks deal {{ aoedamagemod*100 }}% splash damage{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
spells.description: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that hit the enemies closest to Heimerdinger.
spells.tooltip: Heimerdinger fires {{ maxtargets }} enemy seeking Micro-Rocket(s) (max 1 per person), hitting targets nearest to him. Each rocket deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: CH-1 Concussion Grenade
spells.description: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units as well as stunning anyone directly hit and blinding surrounding units.
spells.tooltip: Heimerdinger tosses a grenade, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to enemy units and <status>Blinding</status> them for {{ blindduration }} seconds.  Enemies who are directly hit are <status>Stunned</status> for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: UPGRADE!!!
spells.description: Passive / Active: Passively increases Cooldown Reduction.  Activate to heal all active Evolution Turrets and cause them to fire frost shots, which reduce Movement Speed, for a short time.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: {{ cooldownbonus*-100 }}% Cooldown Reduction.

Active: Empower all abilities and turrets for the duration.

Evolution Turrets: All turrets are fully healed. Each attack applies a {{ movementspeedmod*-100 }}% Slow.
Hextech Micro-Rockets: Fire {{ wmaxmissiles }} rockets.
CH-1 Concussion Grenade: Travels 33% faster.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Techmaturgical Repair Bots
passive.description: Heimerdinger gives nearby allied Turrets and Champions increased Health Regeneration.
